title: The Director's Commentary
desc: Production disasters, method acting madness & industry deep lore

questions.q: Stanley Kubrick was so secretive about 'Eyes Wide Shut' that even the studio didn't see a final cut before what happened?
questions.a: He died — just six days after showing Warner Bros. his final cut, before it was released

questions.q: In 'Apocalypse Now', Martin Sheen suffered a real medical emergency during filming in the Philippines. What was it?
questions.a: A heart attack — he was 36 years old and had to crawl half a mile to get help

questions.q: Which film's production was so troubled it was nicknamed 'Kevin's Gate' after its director?
questions.a: Waterworld (1995) — director Kevin Reynolds clashed with Kevin Costner; it went massively over budget

questions.q: Tarkovsky's 'Stalker' (1979) was filmed near a chemical plant. What happened to several crew members years later?
questions.a: The director, his wife, and actor Anatoly Solonitsyn all died of cancers linked to the toxic shooting location

questions.q: Daniel Day-Lewis famously never broke character during 'My Left Foot'. What did the crew have to do for him throughout filming?
questions.a: Carry him around the set and spoon-feed him — he refused to leave his wheelchair or use his hands

questions.q: The infamous 'Cats' (2019) was so rushed that the initial theatrical release had a visible error. What was it?
questions.a: Judi Dench's human hand (with her wedding ring) was visible — they hadn't finished the CGI fur on it

questions.q: Which Kurosawa film was so influential that George Lucas directly adapted its plot for the original Star Wars?
questions.a: The Hidden Fortress (1958) — the story told through two bickering peasants became C-3PO and R2-D2's perspective

questions.q: The production of 'Jaws' was plagued by a malfunctioning mechanical shark. What did Spielberg name it?
Werner Herzog ate his own shoe on stage after losing a bet with another filmmaker. Who was the filmmaker and what was the bet?
questions.a: Errol Morris — Herzog bet Morris would never finish his documentary 'Gates of Heaven'. Morris finished it.

questions.q: In 'Come and See' (1985), the young lead actor's hair reportedly turned grey during production. The director used live ammunition in some scenes — true or false?
questions.a: True on both counts — real bullets were fired over the actors' heads, and Aleksei Kravchenko's hair greyed from stress
